verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.fireworks.ai that indexes the documentation as markdown pages (probe-1), and doc pages are served as .md with an embedded pointer telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index (probe-2). llms.txt also lists the published OpenAPI specs (supp-openapi-spec), giving agents a machine-readable API surface. missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or single-file full-docs dump, no first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs features.
